skill.name: deploying-kafka-k8s
skill.description: Guides Strimzi-based Apache Kafka deployment on Kubernetes with KRaft, topic management, client testing, monitoring, troubleshooting, and cleanup.
skill.summary: Deploy and operate Strimzi Kafka clusters on Kubernetes with practical manifests, commands, tests, and troubleshooting guidance.
skill.author: Asmayaseen

security_audit.summary: Most external-command findings are Markdown fences, YAML examples, identifiers, or read-only diagnostics and are false positives. Confirmed findings cover cluster-changing kubectl commands, destructive cleanup, and unpinned remote Strimzi manifests. The production example also exposes an unauthenticated plaintext NodePort listener, which requires remediation.

remediation.issue: The production example exposes a plaintext external NodePort listener without authentication.
remediation.suggestion: Enable TLS and supported client authentication, manage certificates securely, and restrict network access before describing the configuration as production-ready.

remediation.issue: Installation, deployment, and cleanup commands consume unversioned latest manifests from remote URLs.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a tested Strimzi version and immutable artifact, verify integrity, and review downloaded manifests before applying or deleting resources.

remediation.issue: The cleanup sequence can delete Kafka data, persistent volumes, operator resources, and the entire namespace.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation, verify the active context and namespace, and document backup or retention checks before destructive commands.

content.user_title: Deploy Kafka on Kubernetes with Strimzi
content.value_statement: Operating Kafka on Kubernetes requires coordinated operator, cluster, topic, and client configuration. This skill provides Strimzi commands, KRaft manifests, tests, monitoring, and troubleshooting steps.
actual_capabilities: Installs the Strimzi operator in a dedicated Kubernetes namespace.
Provides development and three-broker Kafka custom resource examples.
Creates and configures Kafka topics through the Strimzi KafkaTopic resource.
Runs temporary producer, consumer, and topic administration pods for testing.
Documents bootstrap services, metrics configuration, status checks, and troubleshooting commands.
Provides cleanup steps and a basic Dapr Kafka pub/sub component example.
limitations: It does not cover managed Kafka services such as Confluent Cloud or Amazon MSK.
It assumes an existing Kubernetes cluster, kubectl access, suitable permissions, and compatible storage.
Several remote manifests use latest URLs and must be pinned before controlled deployments.
The production example requires TLS, authentication, network restrictions, and environment-specific capacity planning.

use_cases.title: Create a Development Cluster
use_cases.description: Deploy a single-broker Kafka environment for integration testing and local application workflows.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Kubernetes Deployment
use_cases.description: Plan a resilient Strimzi deployment with persistent storage, replication, resources, topics, and secure listeners.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Kafka Operations
use_cases.description: Inspect operator status, broker pods, events, logs, bootstrap services, and common storage or connection failures.

prompt_templates.title: Deploy a Development Cluster
prompt_templates.prompt: Deploy a single-node Strimzi Kafka cluster in namespace [namespace]. Pin compatible versions, explain each change, and wait for readiness before testing.

prompt_templates.title: Create and Test a Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Create topic [topic] with [partitions] partitions and [replicas] replicas. Then outline safe producer and consumer tests inside the cluster.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Production Cluster
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a three-broker Strimzi Kafka cluster for [workload]. Include persistent storage, replication, resource sizing, TLS, authentication, network policy, and monitoring.

prompt_templates.title: Audit and Troubleshoot a Deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the Kafka resources in namespace [namespace]. Identify availability, security, storage, and connectivity risks, then provide ordered diagnostics and reversible remediation steps.

output_examples.input: Prepare a development Kafka cluster in namespace events with one broker.
output_examples.output: A staged plan creates the namespace, pins Strimzi, applies a single-broker resource, waits for readiness, and verifies a test topic.

output_examples.input: Review the provided production listener configuration for security.
output_examples.output: The review flags plaintext external NodePort access and recommends TLS, client authentication, network restrictions, and certificate management before deployment.

output_examples.input: Troubleshoot a Kafka pod that remains unready.
output_examples.output: The diagnostic sequence checks the Kafka resource condition, broker events, pod details, operator logs, storage claims, resource limits, and recent cluster changes.

best_practices: Pin Strimzi, Kafka, and container image versions before applying resources.
Use TLS, client authentication, network policies, and least-privilege Kubernetes access for non-development environments.
Validate storage, replication, capacity, backups, and recovery procedures before production rollout.
anti_patterns: Do not apply unreviewed latest manifests directly to production clusters.
Do not expose plaintext unauthenticated Kafka listeners outside trusted namespaces.
Do not run cleanup commands before confirming context, namespace, labels, backups, and data-retention requirements.

faq.question: Does this skill support managed Kafka services?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on Strimzi-managed Kafka in Kubernetes, not Confluent Cloud, Amazon MSK, or similar services.

faq.question: Does it create a Kubernetes cluster?
faq.answer: No. You need an existing cluster, kubectl connectivity, permissions, and an appropriate storage class.

faq.question: Which software versions appear in the examples?
faq.answer: The examples reference Strimzi 0.49.1 and Kafka 3.9.0. Confirm current compatibility and pin tested versions before deployment.

faq.question: Is the production example ready to apply unchanged?
faq.answer: No. Add TLS, authentication, network controls, storage settings, capacity planning, monitoring, and environment-specific policies.

faq.question: Can the skill verify producer and consumer connectivity?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides temporary in-cluster producer, consumer, and topic administration workflows using Strimzi container images.

faq.question: Can the cleanup steps remove Kafka data?
faq.answer: Yes. They include persistent volume and namespace deletion, so verify context and backups before running them.
